deals.headline: Macquarie takes two charges over Middlesbrough
deals.summary: The club company's only outstanding charges (two of 28 registered) were created on 26 June 2023 and 12 September 2023 in favour of Macquarie Bank Limited, London Branch, each containing a fixed charge; the amounts secured are not stated on the register. Macquarie and Shawbrook Bank held earlier charges (2019, satisfied 2020).

name: Middlesbrough Football Club
notes: Club site (mfc.co.uk) renders client-side, so nothing on it could be read or cited; founded, capacity and leadership come from Teesside Live and the i Paper. The 2024/25 accounts at Companies House are a scanned PDF: turnover £32,476k, operating loss £10,343k and loss before tax £11,419k were read by OCR and match Teesside Live's £32.5m / £11.4m; the operating-loss and stadium-owner evidence sit in that scanned PDF and may not be machine-findable. Broadcast £12.2m is from the same Teesside Live article ('That was the club’s largest source of guaranteed revenue at £12.2m'). Ownership chain from the PSC register: Middlesbrough Football & Athletic Company (1986) Limited <- Middlesbrough Football and Athletic Company Limited (05324467, dormant) <- Middlesbrough Football & Athletic Company Holdings Limited (03912084) <- The Gibson O'Neill Company Limited (02991817; Gibson 75% or more, Crossco (1438) Limited 25-50% and itself Gibson-controlled; Michael O'Neill has significant influence). No stake percentage at club level is stated. Lost the 2026 Championship play-off final 1-0 to Hull City, so still in the Championship for 2026/27. No valuation, attendance, net debt or social counts found on a citable page; no top-flight title.

ownership_summary: Controlled by chairman Steve Gibson, who took ownership in 1994. The club company is held through Middlesbrough Football & Athletic Club Holdings Limited (75% or more) by The Gibson O'Neill Company Limited, the ultimate parent (also owner of Bulkhaul and Rockliffe Hall), in which Gibson holds 75% or more. No institutional or minority investor is on record.
